limitations: Known correlated development cases, not independent strength trials.
The three health-enabled regressions are separate diagnostics; the health rule remains disabled by default.
A handoff or a published answer does not guarantee a positive, currently qualified route or a successful capture.
Current covered endpoints do not certify the flight corridor, future enemy position or survival.
Changed trajectories perform different later work even though live per-tick quotas and parent expiry are unchanged.
No default promotion, deployment or Raspberry Pi performance claim.
